entry.title: Initiative does not appear on PB screen despite being assigned in related items page
entry.content:
Hello Experts,

We are facing an issue in SAP PPM/PS integration and would like to understand whether anyone has encountered similar behavior.

Scenario

When an initiative is assigned to or removed from an item through the Related Items page:

  • The initiative assignment/removal is performed successfully.
  • The initiative description is correctly displayed in the Item Overview tab.
  • However, the corresponding Initiative ID and Initiative Description in Project Builder are not refreshed automatically.

Observed Behavior

The values in Project Builder are updated only after making an additional manual change to the item (for example, modifying the item description, adding a character, and saving again).

Expected Behavior

Project Builder should reflect the latest Initiative ID and Description immediately after the initiative is assigned or removed from the Related Items page, without requiring any additional save action.

SAP Response

We raised an OSS Incident and received the following clarification from SAP:

  • SAP confirmed that DFM synchronization supports either:
    • Initiative ↔ Item synchronization, or
    • Item ↔ PS Project synchronization.
  • The combined synchronization path Initiative ↔ Item ↔ PS Project is not supported in SAP standard.
  • SAP referred to KBA 3515319 – "Synchronization isn't working between Item/PPM-Project/PS-Project".
  • SAP stated that synchronization from Initiative directly through Item to PS Project and vice versa is not delivered in standard SAP code.
  • According to SAP, the observed behavior is working as designed and is therefore not considered a bug.
  • SAP suggested submitting an enhancement request through the Customer Influence / Customer Connection process if this functionality is required in standard product behavior.

Questions

  1. Has anyone implemented a custom solution to automatically synchronize Initiative data from Item to Project Builder?
  2. Is there any BAdI, enhancement spot, event, or workflow exit that can be leveraged to trigger the synchronization?
  3. Is there any standard report, synchronization program, buffer refresh mechanism, or background job that can update Project Builder immediately after Related Item changes?
  4. Has anyone found an SAP Note or recommended workaround other than manually re-saving the item?

Any guidance, implementation experience, or best practices would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you

entry.title: Query on Standard SAP Solution/Tool for RE-FX Contract Migration
entry.content:
Dear SAP Support Team,

We are currently working on a merger project that requires the migration of approximately 5,000 to 60,000 RE-FX master data and contract records within the same SAP client, from one company code to another co. code, also we have scenario we need to migrate contracts in same company code (migrate to different contract type).

We would like to understand whether SAP provides any standard solution, tool, or recommended approach to support this migration process. Specifically, we are looking for a solution that can:

  • Identify and extract the list of RE-FX contracts and related master data to be migrated.
  • Convert or transform the extracted data in line with the configuration and master data setup of the target company code.
  • Load the transformed data into the target company code while maintaining data consistency, relationships, and historical information.
  • Support mass migration with minimal manual intervention.

 

Could you please advise if there is a standard SAP tool, migration cockpit, conversion program, or best practice available for this type of intra-client RE-FX company code migration?

entry.title: delivery for earlier-dated sales order blocked by later-dated order’s confirmation (MTS)
entry.content:
Hello Community

Scenario MTS, same material and plant

Sales order 1 qty 1000, delivery date January confirmed via aATP product availability check

Sales order 2 qty 200, delivery date December created after order 1

Issue
When creating the delivery for order 2 (December, 200), the system does not allow it. The stock is held by the confirmation of order 1. We have to open order 1 via aATP and manually release 200 before the order 2 delivery can be created.

Expected behaviour:
The December delivery should be possible from available physical stock without manually releasing quantity from the January order, and without running Backorder Processing and manual intervention of aATP

Already tried checked

Checking rule for application A, rules 01 and 02 in OVAZ

Product Allocation: not suitable, because it needs quantity maintenance per period.

Question
Which standard configuration or setting lets the delivery of an earlier-dated order use available stock when a later-dated order has already been confirmed against it, without BOP and without manual release If this is not possible in standard aATP, please confirm and advise the recommended standard alternative in SAP S/4 HANA on premise

 

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Regards,

Ashish
